title: Add Pollinations for Obsidian to writing
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Pollinations for Obsidian](https://github.com/tomdacatto/pollinations-obsidian) to writing
- Obsidian plugin: generate text or images from a selection or prompt using the Pollinations API; images save into the vault and embed at the cursor.

Fixes #15666, fixes #15574

gist.headline: A little pollen for your vault
gist.blurb: Pollinations for Obsidian is now in the writing app list. Select some text or write a prompt, then generate words or an image without leaving your notes.
gist.summary: Added the community-built Pollinations for Obsidian plugin to the writing app list; it generates text or images from a selection or prompt, saving images to the vault and embedding them at the cursor.
gist.impact: Obsidian users can find the plugin through Pollinations and place generated images directly into their notes.
gist.visual_concept: Depict an Obsidian-style purple crystal beside an open note on a cozy desk. Polli, wearing a tiny writer's beret, watches a generated picture settle into the note at the cursor; lime-green code-plants grow around the desk.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art writing nook, an open Obsidian-style note beside a purple crystal shows a little landscape picture appearing at the cursor, while lime-green (#ecf874) code-plants grow around the desk. Polli wears a tiny writer's beret and watches warmly: she is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on her cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; keep her small-to-medium in the scene, with chunky retro sprites, a soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
